name: Tales of Maana: Lucy
detailed_description:
Tales of Maana: Lucy is a narrative visual novel set in the enchanting and war-torn world of Maana. Follow Lucy, a determined young girl who joins the Order of Demonists to uncover the legacy of her mother—and begins a journey that will change her forever. Along the way, another tale unfolds in parallel: that of Rose, her rival, whose fate is tightly bound to her own.

A World of Secrets and Wonders

Shaped by centuries of ancient pacts and divine influence, Maana is a land of lost ruins, clashing kingdoms, and fragile harmony between humans and demons. The Eight Divinities guide its cultures and beliefs, but truth is often buried deeper than faith.

A Journey to Find Oneself

Leaving her home behind, Lucy sets out into a world she barely understands—seeking not just answers, but the strength to define who she really is. With each challenge, she grows. With each encounter, her understanding of herself and her world deepens.

Choices That Echo

Every decision matters. Dialogue, actions, and alliances will shape relationships and drive the story toward different outcomes. With two intertwined campaigns offering unique perspectives, your choices carry emotional weight—and lasting consequences.

An Emotional Tale Awaits

Tales of Maana: Lucy weaves a rich narrative filled with magic, rivalries, love, political intrigue, and personal growth. It’s more than a battle of powers—it’s a story of finding your place, embracing your flaws, and carving your own path.

Where certainty ends, her journey begins.
